title: New session
description: Starts a Claude session, the same as the New session page (no attachments). Scheduled daily, it is a session that starts itself with the same prompt every day.

fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.placeholder: Typed into the session as its first message once Claude is up. Required for one-shot.
fields.help: Interactive: optional first message. One-shot: the whole job — Claude runs it, then the session is archived and destroyed.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Session title
fields.help: Shows as the session title in the Claude app. Blank: the session names itself.

options.label: Auto
options.sub: Auto-approve safe actions; the permission classifier gates the rest.

options.label: Interactive
options.sub: Stays up for a conversation in the Claude app until you destroy it.

options.label: One-shot
options.sub: Runs the prompt, then the session is archived + destroyed automatically.

fields.name: auto_pause
fields.label: Auto-pause when idle
fields.help: Interactive only: stops the machine after ~1h with nothing running; Start wakes it with the conversation kept.
